AllowPlayerImport.Name: Allow player imports
AllowPlayerImport.Hint: Players may open the importer and import content into destinations they own.

PlayerDestinations.Name: Player destinations
PlayerDestinations.Hint: Where players may import to. Owned Actors, a GM-controlled staging folder, or both.

AllowedFormats.Name: Allowed input formats
AllowedFormats.Hint: Comma-separated list of input formats: text, markdown, html, json-schema, foundry-export, csv.

MaxInputSize.Name: Maximum input size (characters)
MaxInputSize.Hint: Pasted or uploaded text larger than this is rejected.

MaxBatchSize.Name: Maximum batch size
MaxBatchSize.Hint: Maximum number of documents a single import may create.

AutomationEnabled.Name: Generate automation
AutomationEnabled.Hint: Interpret descriptions and attach validated automation. When disabled, imports contain data and descriptions only.

UseNativeMechanics.Name: Prefer native D&D 5e mechanics
UseNativeMechanics.Hint: Use system activities, uses and effects before any optional integration.

Integrations.Name: Enabled integrations
Integrations.Hint: Comma-separated module ids whose integration adapters may be used when installed.

MacroPolicy.Name: Macro creation policy
MacroPolicy.Hint: Who may have interactive macros generated for them. Generated macros are small wrappers that call the module runtime.
MacroPolicy.Owners: GM and users with script macro permission

ReviewPolicy.Name: Mechanic review policy
ReviewPolicy.Hint: When to require explicit confirmation of interpreted mechanics before import.
ReviewPolicy.Never: Never block on review (unresolved mechanics stay disabled)

DuplicatePolicy.Name: Default duplicate handling
DuplicatePolicy.Hint: What happens when an import matches an existing document.

StagingFolder.Name: Staging folder name
StagingFolder.Hint: Folder used for GM-reviewed player imports.

LogImports.Name: Log imports
LogImports.Hint: Record import reports in the diagnostics log.

DebugMode.Name: Debug mode
DebugMode.Hint: Verbose logging and extra validation output.

AllowHtmlInput.Name: Allow HTML input
AllowHtmlInput.Hint: Accept pasted or uploaded HTML (always sanitized).

OcrEnabled.Name: Enable OCR input
OcrEnabled.Hint: Allow image input through an OCR provider configured by the GM. No provider is bundled.

Permission.PlayersDisabled: The GM has disabled player imports.
Permission.NotActorOwner: You do not own the selected Actor.
Permission.NoWorldCreate: You may not create world documents.
Permission.NoStaging: The staging destination is not available to you.
Permission.GMOnly: Only a Gamemaster may use this destination.
